tasks.answer: Use DeleteDiscussion, the destructive confirmation control for a discussion; pass the discussion id. It wraps the generic ConfirmationDialog (trigger/confirm) and is admin-guarded.
The login form uses Input; it binds react-hook-form through the required registration prop (the UseFormRegisterReturn from register('email'/'password')), spread onto the native input inside a Form.
DiscussionsList renders a paginated Table; the pagination control is TablePagination, which needs totalPages, currentPage and rootUrl (links become rootUrl?page=N).
MDPreview safely renders Markdown via sanitized HTML (DOMPurify); its input prop is value (Markdown string, not pre-rendered HTML).
CreateDiscussion is the admin-only drawer form for creating a discussion; it requires the Authorization provider (only admins see the trigger) and has no props.

notes: All answers from search/get only; no source files read. Task 1 alternative: the generic ui.dialog.confirmation-dialog.ConfirmationDialog (requiredProps: triggerButton, confirmButton, title) is the primitive DeleteDiscussion wraps; DeleteDiscussion chosen because it is the discussion-specific component tagged discussion-delete/confirmation.
